# ByDoctor Public API docs

Source for the ByDoctor public API developer documentation, published at **https://docs.bydoctor.com.br**. Built with [Mintlify](https://mintlify.com).

This is the canonical reference for clinic software vendors and in-house developers integrating with ByDoctor's read-only appointments API and real-time webhooks.

## `openapi.json` is a generated file

`openapi.json` in this repo is a **build artifact** generated by `api-bydoctor`. It is committed here so Mintlify's "Referência da API" section can render it, but **never hand-edit it**.

Whenever the public API contract changes (new field, new filter, new endpoint), regenerate it from `api-bydoctor`:

```bash
cd ../api-bydoctor
python manage.py generate_public_openapi --output ../bydoctor-public-api/openapi.json
```

If the generated reference looks wrong, the fix belongs in the serializers/filters in `api-bydoctor`, not in this file.

## Local preview

Install the Mintlify CLI:

```bash
npm i -g mint
```

Run from the repo root (where `docs.json` lives):

```bash
mint dev
```

View the local preview at `http://localhost:3000`.

## Publishing

The repo owner connects the Mintlify GitHub app and the `docs.bydoctor.com.br` custom domain from the Mintlify dashboard. Changes deploy automatically after pushing to the default branch — this repo does not have its own CI/CD.
